فبدأنا بأربعة عشر طفلاً، ودفترٍ ورقي، وق: So we started with fourteen children, a paper notebook and one rule: every sponsor knows their child's name, photo and report. The rule hasn't changed since that day, but the notebook became a platform.
ومن آلاف الزيارات تعلّمنا شيئاً ثانياً:: Thousands of visits taught us a second thing: most of those we call orphans have a mother, a grandmother or an uncle who loves them but cannot provide for them. So sponsorship goes to the child at home, among their family, not to an institution that takes them away. Hence the name:
، لمّة العيلة التي تبقى حول الطفل، والكا: , the family circle that stays around the child, with the sponsor as one of them.
